description: Header file defining the LearningTaskControllerImpl class, which manages a single learning task including training, feature selection, and prediction within the media learning framework.

classes.name: LearningTaskControllerImpl
classes.description: Implements a controller for managing a single learning task, including training, feature subset selection, and prediction.

methods.name: LearningTaskControllerImpl
methods.description: Constructor initializing the learning task controller with a specific task, optional reporter, and feature provider.

methods.name: BeginObservation
methods.description: Starts a new observation with given features and optional target and source ID.

methods.name: CompleteObservation
methods.description: Completes an observation with the provided completion data.

methods.name: UpdateDefaultTarget
methods.description: Updates the default target for a specific observation.

methods.name: GetLearningTask
methods.description: Returns the current learning task configuration.

methods.name: PredictDistribution
methods.description: Predicts the distribution for given features and executes callback with results.

methods.name: AddFinishedExample
methods.description: Adds a completed example to training data and processes it.

methods.name: OnModelTrained
methods.description: Handles actions after model training completes.

methods.name: SetTrainerForTesting
methods.description: Sets a custom trainer for testing purposes.

methods.name: DoFeatureSubsetSelection
methods.description: Performs feature subset selection based on task settings.
